Given the problem explicitly calls out efficiency and a large-input timed test, this is a missed opportunity to state a mechanism.

The session ended immediately after the passing run with no discussion of why the fix worked, what algorithm was used, or its complexity characteristics — a pure end-session with no articulated root cause or approach recap.
